title: Active and Allosteric Site Binding MOLECULAR MECHANICS-QUANTUM MECHANICS studies of STEVIOSIDE Derivative in PCSK9 Protein Intended to provide a safe Antilipidemic agent
authors: N Irfan; Prakash Vaithyanathan; Harishchander Anandaram; S Mohammed Zaidh; S Priya Varshini; A Puratchikody
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甜菊糖衍生物与PCSK9蛋白的分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Interaction of low-density lipoprotein receptors with proprotein convertase subtilisin/ kexin type 9 (PCSK9) plays a vital role in causing atherosclerosis. It is the hidden precursor of clinical myocardial infarction (MI), stroke, CVD and estimates 60% of deaths worldwide. The current need is to design small molecules to prevent the interaction between PCSK9 with LDL receptors. This study aims to evaluate the PCSK9 antagonistic effect of a derivative of Stevioside (also referred as Methylidene tetracyclo derivative) and atorvastatin. Also, a comparative study was performed to analyze the binding interaction of molecules inside the active and allosteric sites of PCSK9. The RCSB downloaded protein 7S5H and above said ligands were optimized to the local minima energy level and docked inside the active and allosteric sites. The stability of non-bonded interaction of complex was analyzed using Desmond MD simulation studies. The results of docking showed that the Methylidene tetracyclo molecule possesses a two-fold higher affinity of -10.159 kcal/mol in the active site and -10.824 kcal/mol in the allosteric site. The Phe377 amino acid made the Methylidene tetracyclo molecule orient inside the active site. Nine H-bonds with 5 amino acids of allosteric site increase the binding affinity compared to Atorvastatin. The MD simulation studies exposed that the nonbonded interaction of Methylidene tetracyclo molecule was stable throughout 100ns. This confirms the Methylidene tetracyclo molecule will be the better hit as well as the lead molecule to inhibit PCSK9 protein.
abstract_zh: 低密度脂蛋白受体与前蛋白转化酶枯草溶菌素/kexin 9型（PCSK9）的相互作用在导致动脉粥样硬化中起着至关重要的作用。它是临床心肌梗死（MI）、中风、心血管疾病（CVD）的隐匿前兆，并估计占全球死亡率的60%。当前的需求是设计小分子以阻止PCSK9与LDL受体之间的相互作用。本研究旨在评估甜菊糖苷衍生物（也称为亚甲基四环衍生物）和阿托伐他汀的PCSK9拮抗作用。此外，还进行了比较研究，以分析分子在PCSK9活性位点和变构位点内的结合相互作用。从RCSB下载的蛋白质7S5H及上述配体被优化至局部最小能量水平，并分别对接至活性位点和变构位点。使用Desmond分子动力学（MD）模拟研究分析了复合物非键相互作用的稳定性。对接结果显示，亚甲基四环分子在活性位点具有-10.159 kcal/mol的亲和力，在变构位点具有-10.824 kcal/mol的亲和力，其亲和力高出两倍。Phe377氨基酸使亚甲基四环分子在活性位点内定向。与阿托伐他汀相比，变构位点5个氨基酸形成的9个氢键增加了结合亲和力。MD模拟研究揭示，亚甲基四环分子的非键相互作用在100纳秒内保持稳定。这证实亚甲基四环分子将是抑制PCSK9蛋白的更好先导化合物及候选分子。
